Canada denies evidence of Indian government involvement in Nijjar murder

Canadian police have ruled out any connection between the Indian government and the murder of Sikh separatist Baljit Singh Sodhi, also known as Nijjar. The incident occurred on January 27 at a gurudwara in Quebec City, Canada. The Canadian government has stated that there is no evidence to suggest the involvement of the Indian government in the killing. This development comes amid tensions between India and Canada over the extradition of Sikh separatist Kulvir Singh Rakhwal.
